representation: Rust facade contract description; not a general JSON codec
semantics: False CDL.Utilities.Assert input emits Warning on every evaluation, including repeated false and equal-time calls; true is silent.
Other block classes may warn; sources are not guaranteed instance identities. No latch, warn-once, escalation, scheduler or safety policy.
Every accepted complete frame retains emitted warnings in evaluator emission order, without sorting or deduplication.
Frame execution calls no Store method. A completed result is not a durability or equipment-delivery receipt.

CompletedFrame.diagnostics.accessor: borrowed &[AssertEvent] of independently owned immutable warnings
CompletedFrame.diagnostics.lifetime: later execution, reload, resume or restore cannot change a retained result
